# Cohen Pert

> Entrepreneur, operator, and investor in Cumming, Georgia. Founder & CEO of Pert Digital and Managing Director of The Pert Group.

I build businesses, improve how they run, and invest for the long term. Pert Digital is a growth and operations partner for local home-service businesses. The Pert Group LLC is the private parent and holding company behind Pert Digital and future ventures.
